import pathlib,os,json,subprocess
p=pathlib.Path('/scratch/probe')
print('before_exists',p.exists())
print('scratch_mounts_before',*[l for l in pathlib.Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text().splitlines() if ' /scratch' in l],sep='\n')
p.mkdir()
print('probe_created',p.is_dir(),'is_symlink',p.is_symlink(),'is_mount',os.path.ismount(p))
print('probe_exact_mountinfo', [l for l in pathlib.Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text().splitlines() if l.split()[4]=='/scratch/probe'])
print('security_status',*[l for l in pathlib.Path('/proc/self/status').read_text().splitlines() if l.startswith(('CapEff:','CapBnd:','NoNewPrivs:','Seccomp:'))],sep='\n')
print('lsm',pathlib.Path('/proc/self/attr/current').read_text().strip())
r=subprocess.run(['mount','--fake','-t','tmpfs','-o','size=1m,nosuid,nodev,noexec','zeros-smoke','/scratch/probe'],capture_output=True,text=True)
print('fake_mount_exit',r.returncode,'stdout',r.stdout,'stderr',r.stderr)
print('probe_after_fake_is_mount',os.path.ismount(p))
print('No real mount/chroot syscall was requested')
